title: Crow Creek Golf

services.name: Golf lesson
services.desc: In 2006 he accepted a position with Elite Golf Cruises as a golf professional on board cruise ships. Mike quickly established himself as one of the top teachers and club fitters in the fleet. Between 2007 and 2008 he was one of the top three professionals in the company in lessons, club fittings, and leading excursions. Upon returning to solid ground in 2010, Mike served as first assistant and head of instruction at Crow Creek for two years. In 2012 Mike advanced his career by accepting the Head Golf Professional position at The Pearl. His hard work and character led to a promotion to General Manager in 2013. In the fall of 2018, Mike returned to Crow Creek as the Director of Golf. Crow

blurb: Located in the quaint fishing village of Calabash, NC, Crow Creek Golf Club is an 18 hole public course designed by architect, Rick Robbins. Since opening in 2000, the course has maintained the reputation for being one of the most immaculately maintained courses along the east coast.
